name: stat

provenance.source: exact 4.100.155 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64 (PowerManager, MiWearScreen, miwear_vibrator library and property library review)

notes: NuttX stat into a 104-byte struct stat: st_mode at +8, st_size (int64) at +32, st_atim/st_mtim/st_ctim as 16-byte timespecs from +56. The filesystem's own stat operation fills the times; returns -1 and sets errno on failure. Supervisor platform hardware service; static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
